ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an isoline schematic diagram of a certain area in the Hexi Corridor, and the legend indicates that the dashed lines represent “annual precipitation/mm”. In the figure, smaller precipitation values can be seen near the northern part, such as 100; the precipitation isoline values near the southern part are relatively larger, such as 150. Then reason: The smaller the value of an equal-precipitation line, the less the precipitation, so along the direction from south to north, the precipitation changes from a larger value to a smaller value, indicating that the precipitation in this area gradually decreases from south to north.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：这是河西走廊地区的等值线示意图，图例里有“年降水量/mm”的等值线，图中北侧可见较小的降水标注（如100），而南侧对应的降水值更高。再看文字：题目问“降水量从南向北呈怎样的变化趋势”。根据等值线读图规则，等降水量线的数值越小表示降水越少，所以沿南→北方向，降水量是逐渐减少的，即自南向北递减。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是河西走廊某地区等值线示意图，图例标明虚线表示“年降水量/mm”。图中北部附近可见较小的降水量数值，如100；南部附近的降水量等值线数值相对更大，如150。再推理：等降水量线数值越小表示降水越少，因此沿南向北方向，降水量由较大值变为较小值，说明该地区降水量自南向北逐渐减少。
